clauses.title: Scope
clauses.text: This standard covers whole wheat flour (atta) obtained by grinding clean wheat. It specifies the requirements for quality, hygiene, and packaging of wheat flour meant for human consumption.

clauses.title: Quality Requirements for Wheat Flour
clauses.text:
Requirements for wheat flour (atta):
- Moisture: Not more than 14.0% by mass
- Total ash (on dry basis): Not more than 2.0% by mass
- Acid insoluble ash: Not more than 0.1% by mass
- Gluten (dry basis): Not less than 7.5% by mass
- Uric acid: Not more than 100 mg/kg
- Aflatoxin: Not more than 15 µg/kg
- The flour shall be free from added colouring matter, rodent hair, excreta fragments, and insect fragments beyond prescribed limits.
